item.body:
## Issue
Closes #629
Claim: mac/ux05-sonnet

## What and why
Final wording of the user survey: `docs/ux/questionnaire/questions.md` (French). One block per ID of `cadrage-construction.md` §2 in the §3.2 format: `E0`, `P1`–`P3`, `O1`, `L1`–`L2`, `D1`–`D2`, `C01`–`C10`, `C11`, `M1`, `F1`, `I1`, `E1`, each with its tri §4 section and stable ASCII codes. Plus the HFR topic announcement and the TestFlight note (not transcribed by the form).
- PO decisions of 2026-11-08 applied: `L1` has a third answer `comme_aujourdhui` (D1), pseudo `I1` at the end (D2).
- `I1` note: optional, deletion on request to Bruno Arene, ezzz75@gmail.com. Must be checked against #630 at merge.
- Choices to validate: `D1` per-card states `garder` / `deplier` / `ecarter` plus a `comme_aujourdhui` answer; `L2` shown only if `L1` answered; `C11` capped at 280 characters like `F1`; E1 shows the pre-threshold message (D3).
- Nothing classed Non by the PO appears; `L1` lists only WebView-possible improvements.

## How it was verified
`npx -y markdownlint-cli2@0.18.1`: 0 errors. Every question of tri §4 checked against the file (section "Contrôle" of the document).

## Checklist (AGENTS.md §9)
- [x] No secrets; docs only
- [ ] Author model: Sonnet 5.5 / Reviewer model: Opus 5.5 (review requested, not done by the author)

The scope is complete and the structure is sound. One must-fix: the pseudo text does not match the data notice. The other findings are small edits.

Checked against issue #629 (D1, D2), `tri-m5-decisions.md` §3.5, §4 and §4.7, `cadrage-construction.md` §2 and §3, and `donnees.md` §1 on the PR #669 branch.

## What passes

- Every element of tri §4 is present with its construction §2 ID and tri section. The flow order matches §2: `E0`, `P1`–`P3`, `O1`, `L1`/`L2`, `D1`/`D2`, `C01`–`C10`, `C11`, `M1`, `F1`, `I1`, `E1`.
- D1 is applied (`L1` has `comme_aujourdhui` "Garder les pages comme aujourd'hui"). D2 is applied (`I1` comes after `F1`, just before `E1`).
- All five §3.2 fields are present, in order, in every block. The codes are lowercase ASCII and unique within each question.
- No proposal classed Non appears. `L1` shows only improvements possible with the WebView: no swipe that follows the finger, no line-exact position, no scrubber. The `D2` preview is the local one. No card promises an alert when you are quoted, and no card names a host or a technique.
- Time: about 18 single choices plus the `D1` sort and 4 optional text fields, which is about 22 interactions. This fits the construction §2 budget (6 min 20 s on iPad, 4 min 20 s on iPhone).

## Findings, by severity

1. **High: `I1` (line 176) does not state the facts of `donnees.md` §1.** The help text gives only the deletion contact. It leaves out four facts the PO decided on 2026-11-08:
   - the pseudo serves only so Bruno can write to the participant by MP;
   - it is never displayed or published;
   - it is erased on `{date_effacement}`, two months after closing;
   - the link to the detail page ("Vos données et vos droits").

   It also lacks the field help "Indiquez seulement votre propre pseudo." As written, a respondent decides on the pseudo without knowing what it is used for or when it is erased.
   **Fix:** use the `donnees.md` §1 short text verbatim as the `Aide`, with the field label "Pseudo HFR" and the help under the field. The e-mail address can stay on the detail page, which already lists it with the one-month response delay. Then replace the "à vérifier à la fusion" line (212) with a check done against #669.

2. **Medium: the card-section header sits in `C01`'s `Aide` (line 85), but `C01`–`C10` are shown in random order for each respondent (construction §2).** Wherever `C01` lands, the header either appears in the middle of the list or depends on a special case the form has to guess. The randomisation itself is not mentioned anywhere in the file.
   **Fix:** set `C01` Aide to "(aucune)". Add a short note before the `C01` block, outside the ID blocks, such as "Écran Cartes : en tête, « Ce sont des pistes à l'étude, pas des engagements. » Ordre des cartes tiré au hasard pour chaque répondant." Add the same rule to "Règles de lecture".

3. **Medium: the duration is understated for iPad respondents** (`E0` line 22, announcement title line 192, TestFlight note line 204). "environ 5 minutes" holds for the iPhone path only. The iPad path is budgeted at 6 min 20 s, with a 7-minute cap. Underselling the length costs completions and trust.
   **Fix:** "5 à 7 minutes" (or "moins de 7 minutes") in all three places.

4. **Low: the `E0` link label does not match the data notice.** `donnees.md` §1 asks the wording to use "Vos données : ce qui est gardé et pourquoi". `E0` says "Lire la mention sur les données".
   **Fix:** use the #669 label.

5. **Low: `D1` `Réponses` (line 70) packs three code sets into one line:** sections, per-card states, and the standalone `comme_aujourdhui`. The #634 parity test reads `` `code` Libellé `` items separated by `·`, so this line cannot be parsed unambiguously.
   **Fix:** keep the `Réponses` field and split it into labelled sub-bullets: "Sections : …", "État de chaque carte : …", "Réponse seule : …", "Ordre : choisi par le répondant". Tell #633 and #634 about this layout.

6. **Low: the first sentences of `E1` (line 183) contradict the pre-threshold message.** "Voici vos réponses à côté de celles des autres utilisateurs" is shown even when there are not yet enough answers to display.
   **Fix:** make that sentence conditional on the threshold. Also state the construction §4 rule: closed questions only, never free text or a pseudo.

## Nitpicks

- `C03`: "MP de groupe" while `C04` and `M1` say "MP à plusieurs". Use "MP à plusieurs" everywhere.
- `D1` card states: "Je la veux, et dépliable" is awkward. Suggest `garder` "Dans la barre" and `deplier` "Dans la barre, et dépliable".
- `L2` after `L1` = `comme_aujourdhui`: "Qu'est-ce qui vous manquerait avec ce choix ?" reads oddly when nothing changes. Either show `L2` only for the two scenarios, or reword it to "Qu'est-ce qui compte le plus pour vous dans ce choix ?"
- `P1` is optional and gates theme 2, so a respondent who skips it never sees `D1`/`D2`. Suggest the help text "Votre réponse adapte les questions suivantes."
